# Repository Contribution Policy

Version: 1.0.2
Initial Publication Date: 2026-06-04
Last Updated: 2026-06-14

This repository is not an open source project and is not maintained as a community contribution project. The Original Materials are governed by the independent license stated in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE), and the License Text controls for the Original Materials. Public GitHub visibility and the GitHub Platform Terms do not grant permission to Use the Original Materials beyond [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE).

## External Contributions Are Not Accepted

An External Contribution is not accepted. Do not submit Contribution Materials, including pull requests, patches, source code changes, documentation changes, translations, design assets, generated files, datasets, feature implementations, refactoring proposals, shader rewrites, saved worlds, or artificial-intelligence-generated material.

A pull request may be closed without review. A Public Issue or other public submission that proposes or submits Contribution Materials may also be closed without review.

## Public Issues

A Public Issue is limited to a problem report, a limited question, or a request for a Private Reporting Channel for a Security Report. A Public Issue is not a channel for an External Contribution, replacement text, code review submissions, asset submissions, dataset submissions, or design proposals.

A Public Issue must not contain vulnerability details, exploit steps, proof-of-concept code, credentials, tokens, cookies, logs containing secrets, private local files, third-party confidential information, or other information unsuitable for public disclosure.

## Security Reports

A Security Report is governed by the Security Reporting Policy stated in [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md). If a suspected vulnerability may require non-public technical detail, use a Private Reporting Channel, such as GitHub private vulnerability reporting or a GitHub security advisory, when available. If no Private Reporting Channel is available, open only a minimal Public Issue requesting a private contact method.

## Ordinary Application Use

This policy does not restrict Ordinary Application Use of Ludoxel, including ordinary play, local user-data saving, ordinary screenshots, ordinary screen recordings, or the User-Created Materials and Application Output described in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE).

## Controlling Terms

This document states the repository contribution policy. If this document conflicts with [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE), the License Text controls for the Original Materials. The GitHub Platform Terms may govern the relationship between GitHub and its users, but those terms do not expand the permissions granted by the Licensor for the Original Materials.
